scope: 完整调查 HTTP 提交/发布的源码清单；供统筹与最终暂存内容对照；不是当前 Git 差异或现役服务证明。
method: AST、源码路径及源码散列；不导入应用、不读取配置值/业务证据、不操作 Git/index、不执行业务测试。
complete_build_note: 完整打包包含静态不可达模块与非 Python 资源；文件存在不代表该路由已注册或该组件被启动。
closure_limitations: 静态导入含函数内导入及包初始化，不代表所有依赖均在启动时执行。
不解析动态 executor_factory 的配置值；运行组件的发布接线由核心与统筹负责。
全量 app + investigation_http 源包用于覆盖 SQL/模板/配置示例等非导入资源；配置实际值未读取。

unverified_boundaries: 当前 Git/index、main/远端/父项目引用及最终暂存内容由统筹独立核对。
本地源码不证明现役 HTTP 或平台代理已加载 Q34/Q35；保留先前错误证据，归统一 HTTP 发布。
未构建、启动、迁移、重启、联网探测、提交新任务或调用模型。
已有证据只索引路径，未重新读取业务结果，不能把旧批通过推广为本次部署通过。
manage.py 没有 rollback 子命令；发布前由统筹绑定保存的旧 image/compose/config/mount 清单并验证数据库兼容。

bounded_http_boundary_fix.reached: Q34/Q35/POST; exact final paths/components equality; remaining legacy alias and internal-boundary checks.
bounded_http_boundary_fix.runtime_boundary: Offline schema/import/logging/TestClient only; no real service, PG or model validation.
bounded_http_boundary_fix.audit_strengthening: Reconstructed legacy alert field component is derived from current single-request schema and fully compared before insertion; batch changes update only two explicitly asserted keys.
bounded_http_boundary_fix.baseline_handling: Original OpenAPI baseline retained. Explicit enumerated published/approved field/type/required/reference/description assertions precede normalization.
bounded_http_boundary_fix.historical_results: All prior failed and passed test-run artifacts preserved.
bounded_http_boundary_fix.git_scope: Only earlier authorized source reads; no Git/index writes or branch changes, and no subsequent Git operations.
